item.title: T.I. Reveals He’s Performing Something From His New Album at the BET Awards | BET Awards 2026
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome back to 'The Scoop'! I've got some exciting news to share with you all. Recently, at the BET Awards 2026, a special conversation took place on the red carpet. None other than the legendary T.I. sat down with Billboard's very own Kyle Denis. We don't have the details of what they discussed, but we do know that these two industry insiders had a chance to chat. We'll keep an eye out for any updates from their conversation. That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in to 'The Scoop'!"
[Upbeat music starts playing again]
